# Test pe init command

# Initialize in clean directory
exec pe init
stdout 'Initialized PE repository'
exists .pe
exists .pe/cache
exists .pe/modules
exists .pe/config
exists .pe/config/pe.yaml
exists .peignore

# Initialize with custom directory
mkdir myproject
cd myproject
exec pe init
exists .pe
cd ..

# Re-initialize should fail
! exec pe init
stderr 'already initialized'

# Initialize with --force
exec pe init --force
stdout 'Initialized PE repository'
